ToolButton.tooltip: Restart: stop the run and play again from the start
Play: run the project as the player runs it (Play New Instance in the Game menu opens another)
Pause: hold the run, its sound with it; again resumes
Stop: end the run; nothing it did is kept

Label.tooltip: Play starts once the cook finishes, so the run binds what was just built

ComboBox.tooltip: The resolution the game draws at, fitted into the tab as the player fits it into its window

ToolButton.tooltip: Phone: the game on a phone's screen held upright, turned when it is held the other way
